name: Affairs
overview: Scripture warns against the dangers of affairs, including emotional and extramarital ones, emphasizing the need for purity and vigilance. Proverbs cautions believers to avoid the allure of the 'strange woman' who flatters with her words, highlighting the destructive consequences of hidden sin and the importance of confession and repentance. Jesus teaches that even lustful thoughts are equivalent to committing adultery in the heart, underscoring the call to holiness in both actions and intentions. Boldness in righteousness and openness in rebuke are encouraged as means to confront and overcome sin, while trusting in wickedness leads to spiritual downfall.
